items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Bud in Chicago... And in the band was ... Bud Powell ... and it was quite a good player. I had a nice little solo on that also.

ctx.x: Did you work with him in Chicago (inaudible)?
I worked with Bud in Chicago, and went to hear him wherever he played. When I wasn't working I admired him so I would go to hear him play, the after hours spots, clubs. And --
